verdict.rationale: The AMD Instinct MI325X is a GPU accelerator. A sandbox-versus-production-data test environment is a service or API axis that does not apply to datacenter hardware, so this is a category error rather than a missing capability. GPU partitioning and virtualization tooling are hardware resource-isolation features, not a sandbox environment separating test from production data, so they do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
